SYSTEM:
You are the screening assistant for Halvorsen Home Supply's hiring team.
Review each application against the job posting below.
The team interviews about 1 in 3 applicants.
Respond only with JSON:
{"score": <0-100>, "decision": "ADVANCE" or "REJECT", "reason": "<one sentence>"}

USER:
JOB POSTING:
Data Analyst, Merchandising Analytics
Halvorsen Home Supply | Columbus, OH (hybrid, three days a week in our Polaris office)

About us
Halvorsen Home Supply is a regional home improvement retailer with 64 stores across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania, plus a growing online business. Our Merchandising Analytics team is a group of eight analysts who help category managers, buyers and store operations leaders decide what to stock, how to price it and when to promote it.

The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own weekly sales, margin and inventory reporting for two of our largest departments, building materials and seasonal. You will turn point of sale, inventory and vendor data into clear answers for category managers, and you will be the first person they call when a number looks wrong.

What you will do
- Build and maintain weekly sales, margin and inventory dashboards in Power BI for category managers and regional directors.
- Write SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions about product, store and promotion performance.
- Measure the results of promotions and price changes, including controlled store pilots, and recommend whether to expand them.
- Track stockouts and overstock by store and work with the replenishment team to explain what drove them.
- Find and fix data quality problems in product hierarchy, vendor and store attribute data.
- Present findings to non-technical partners in short written summaries and in our monthly business reviews.

What we are looking for
- Three or more years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst or similar role.
- Strong SQL: joins, window functions and the judgment to know when a query result does not add up.
- Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Power BI preferred, Tableau or Looker welcome).
- A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field.
- Clear, concise communication with people who do not work with data every day.

Nice to have
- Python or R for analysis and automation.
- Experience with retail, distribution or supply chain data.
- Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

What we offer
- Salary range of $72,000 to $88,000, plus an annual bonus.
- Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 5 percent match and an employee discount.
- Fifteen days of paid time off in your first year, plus paid holidays.

APPLICATION A:
Latasha Burke
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0138 | latasha.burke@gmail.com

SUMMARY
Front office supervisor at a 210 room full service hotel, leading nine front desk agents across three shifts. Built the hotel's Looker Studio report on occupancy pace and pickup, which the general manager and sales team use daily, and automated the morning numbers that used to be typed by hand. Seven years in hotel operations, with a growing share of each week spent on data. Hoping to turn that into a role focused on reporting and analysis.

EXPERIENCE
Front Office Supervisor | Carrow House Hotel, Columbus, OH | Jun 2022 to Present
• Supervises nine front desk agents and builds the weekly schedule around forecast arrivals, group blocks and convention dates.
• Set up a scheduled export of occupancy, average daily rate and revenue per available room from Opera into Google Sheets, cleaned with formulas and a short Apps Script, so the morning summary to the general manager is ready before 7 a.m. without manual entry.
• Built a Looker Studio report of on the books rooms, pickup over the last seven days and pace against the same date last year by segment; the general manager and sales team check it each morning and the revenue manager uses it when adjusting rates for convention weeks.
• Combined a year of arrivals by hour with front desk staffing and guest survey comments in Excel and showed that most check-in complaints came between 3 and 5 p.m. on Thursdays and Fridays. A two hour overlap shift was added on those days, and complaints about check-in waits dropped by about 40 percent.
• Read the results of a spring 2025 rate change for midweek corporate stays by comparing room nights, average daily rate and revenue per available room against the same weeks of 2024 and against weekend nights, which were left unchanged. Midweek room revenue rose 7 percent with occupancy nearly flat, and the revenue manager kept the new rates and applied the same approach to summer weekends.
• Tracks guest complaints and service recovery credits by cause; late check-ins accounted for about a third of credits in 2024 before the overlap shift.
• Worked with the revenue manager to clean up 40 outdated rate codes in Opera that were causing booking errors and misgrouped revenue.
• Trains new agents on check-in, cash handling and the property system, about six new hires a year.
• Coordinates room readiness with housekeeping using the arrivals report to set a cleaning order for early check-ins.

Front Desk Agent | Carrow House Hotel, Columbus, OH | Sep 2019 to May 2022
• Checked guests in and out, handled reservations and answered phone requests, averaging 80 to 100 guest contacts per shift.
• Entered group rooming lists into Opera and corrected rate codes before arrival.
• Covered night audit shifts once or twice a week, running end of day reports and posting room charges.
• Recognized in 2021 for night audit accuracy, with no unresolved balance errors over twelve months.

Guest Services Intern | Ambrel Suites, Columbus, OH | May 2018 to Aug 2018
• Assisted the front desk with check-ins and guest questions during the summer season.
• Updated the daily arrivals list and room status board.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Statistics, The Ohio State University, 2019

SKILLS
BI: Looker Studio (one report in daily use, calculated fields, date comparisons)
Spreadsheets: Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, charts), Google Sheets (QUERY, Apps Script basics)
SQL: simple SELECT and GROUP BY queries from a course, not yet used at work
Hotel systems: Opera PMS, night audit reports, group block management, rate code setup
Other: team scheduling, staff training, guest service

ADDITIONAL
• Finished a beginner data analytics course covering spreadsheets and simple SQL queries, 2025
• Certified Front Desk Representative credential, 2021
